title: Policy changes
lines: Potion mix: now "All mana potions" (was "The build's own mix (today's rule)"). After, 15 min: mana potions drunk: 3, healing potions drunk: 0, rejuvenation potions drunk: 0, deaths: 2, deaths with no potion drunk just before: 1 (U). Before, 15 min: mana potions drunk: 1, healing potions drunk: 1, rejuvenation potions drunk: 0, deaths: 0, deaths with no potion drunk just before: 0 (U).
(U) marks a counter whose link to the setting is a guess, not a measurement. 'Not reported' means no event carries it yet.
